Returns & Cancellations Policy
At Surfaces Tiles Ltd, we want you to be completely satisfied with your porcelain tile purchase. If for any reason you are not satisfied, we offer a hassle-free returns and exchanges process. Please read the following guidelines carefully:
Where The Products Received Are Damaged Or Incorrect, Please Inform Us Within 48 Hours with photographs of the received goods And We Will Arrange A Replacement.
Where The Products You Receive Are Different From The Sample You Purchased Or The Order You Placed, We Ask That You Return Them In A Resaleable State, Undamaged, Unused, And In The Same Packaging They Were Received. A Replacement/refund Will Be Processed Within 7 Working Days Following The Receipt Of The Return Via The Original Payment Method.
We Do Not Provide Replacements Or Refunds For Change Of Choice After The Product Has Been Delivered In Perfect Condition. We Advise That You Make Your Selections Carefully, And Speak To Our Tile Specialist Team (If Need Be) For Guidance On The Best Product For Your Need.
Surfaces Tiles, reserves The Right Not To Refund Or Replace If The Products Are Deemed Not Resaleable, Returned After 60 Days, Or Without Proof Of Payment. When Returning Products, We Advise That They Are Carefully Packaged, Insured, And Tracked. Refunds/replacements Will Not Also Be Issued For Products Damaged In Return Transit Or Return Not Received At All.
Kindly Email Us At sales@surfacestiles.co.uk Or Call 07877968447 For All Returns. Endeavour To Provide Proof Of Purchase, Order Number, The Amount Of Product Received/being Returned, And The Reason For Your Return.
Eligibility for Returns and Exchanges
We accept returns and exchanges within 28 days from the date of delivery.
The tiles must be unused, in their original packaging, and in the same condition as when they were received.
Custom or special order tiles may not be eligible for return or exchange. Please contact our customer support team for more information.
Initiating a Return or Exchange
To initiate a return or exchange, please contact our customer support team either by Phone or Mail. Provide your order number and details of the items you wish to return or exchange.
Our customer support team will guide you through the process and provide you with a return authorization number (RMA) if applicable.
Return Shipping
Customers are responsible for the cost of return shipping   unless the return is due to an error on our part (e.g., wrong item shipped, damaged item).
We recommend using a trackable shipping method to ensure the safe return of the items. We are not responsible for any lost or damaged returns in transit.
Please note that the original delivery charges will not be refunded.
Refunds and Store Credit
Once we receive the returned items and verify their condition, we will process the refund or exchange.
Refunds will be issued to the original payment method used during the purchase. Please allow 7-8 working days for the refund to be reflected in your account.
If you opt for a store credit, it will be issued in the form of a digital voucher that can be used for future purchases on our website.
Exclusions and Special Considerations
Samples cannot be returned or exchanged. They are intended to provide a representation of the tile’s color, texture, and finish.
If you received damaged or defective tiles, please contact our customer support team within 48 hours with photographs of delivery to arrange for a replacement or refund.
Cancellations
You can cancel your order anytime before it’s shipped at Surfaces Tiles.
We value your satisfaction and offer a flexible cancellation policy to ensure your peace of mind.
Contact Us
If you have any questions, concerns, or need assistance regarding our Returns and Exchanges process, please don’t hesitate to contact our customer support team. We’re here to help!

What is porcelain tile ?
Porcelain tile is a type of tile that is made from finely ground clay minerals, such as kaolinite, along with other materials such as feldspar, quartz, and various pigments. These raw materials will carefully select and they will be processed to create a homogeneous mixture. The mixture will be shaped into the desired file form through methods like extrusion or piercing.
The special qualities of porcelain tiles are due to their high firing process. Usually over 2100 degrees Fahrenheit (1150 Celsius). This process is more intense than the second tile. High temperatures transform clay minerals and other components into vitrified materials. As a result, the tile becomes strong, hard, and abrasion resistant. Read More>>
How is porcelain tile different from ceramic tile?
Porcelain tile and ceramic tile may look similar, but there are some key differences between them. Here's how porcelain tile differs from ceramic tile:
Composition: Porcelain tile is made of fine porcelain clay and is fired at a higher temperature than ceramic tile. This makes it denser, harder, and less porous compared to ceramic tile.
Durability: Porcelain tile is highly durable and resistant to wear, scratches, and stains. It is suitable for high-traffic areas and is known for its longevity. Ceramic tile is less durable and more prone to chipping and cracking.
Water Absorption: Porcelain tile has a lower water absorption rate, usually less than 0.5%. It is considered impervious or vitreous, making it suitable for areas with high moisture, such as bathrooms and kitchens. Ceramic tile has a higher water absorption rate, typically above 0.5%.
Versatility: Porcelain tile can be used both indoors and outdoors, thanks to its low water absorption and frost resistance. It is also available in a wide range of finishes, including polished, matte, and textured. Ceramic tile is primarily recommended for indoor use.
Maintenance: Due to its low porosity, porcelain tile is easier to clean and maintain. It is less likely to absorb stains or harbor bacteria. Ceramic tile may require more frequent cleaning and sealing to prevent staining and moisture penetration.
Price: Porcelain tile is generally more expensive than ceramic tile due to its higher quality and durability. Ceramic tile is often a more budget-friendly option.
When choosing between porcelain and ceramic tile, consider the specific needs of your project, the level of foot traffic, and the desired aesthetic to make an informed decision. Read More
What are the advantages of using porcelain tiles?
Porcelain tiles offer several advantages that make them a popular choice for both residential and commercial spaces. First, their exceptional durability ensures they can withstand heavy foot traffic without losing their appearance or integrity. They are highly resistant to scratches, wear, and impact, making them suitable for high-traffic areas. Second, porcelain tiles have low water absorption rates, making them highly resistant to moisture. This makes them ideal for areas prone to water exposure, such as bathrooms and kitchens. Additionally, their non-porous surface provides stain resistance, easy maintenance, and versatility in design options. With their fade resistance, low maintenance requirements, and allergy-friendly properties, porcelain tiles provide a durable, beautiful, and practical flooring solution. Read more
Are porcelain tiles suitable for both residential and commercial use?
Yes, porcelain tiles are suitable for both residential and commercial use. They offer exceptional durability and can withstand heavy foot traffic, making them ideal for high-traffic areas in commercial settings such as offices, hotels, restaurants, and retail spaces. In residential applications, porcelain tiles are a popular choice for various areas including kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, entryways, and even outdoor spaces. They are designed to withstand the demands of daily use, providing a long-lasting flooring solution that maintains its appearance and performance over time. Additionally, the versatility of porcelain tiles in terms of design options and aesthetics makes them suitable for a wide range of residential and commercial interior styles. Read More

Are porcelain tiles suitable for bathroom floors and walls?
Yes, porcelain tiles are an excellent choice for bathroom floors and walls due to their durability, water resistance, and low maintenance. They are resistant to stains, moisture, and humidity, making them ideal for bathroom environments. Explore Bathroom Porcelain Tiles.
Can porcelain tiles be used in shower areas and around bathtubs?
Porcelain tiles are suitable for shower areas and around bathtubs, offering a waterproof and easy-to-clean surface. Choose textured or slip-resistant porcelain tiles for shower floors to enhance safety.
Do porcelain tiles require sealing in bathroom applications?
Porcelain tiles are naturally resistant to water and stains, so they typically do not require sealing for bathroom applications. However, sealing grout lines with a suitable grout sealer can enhance durability and prevent staining.
Are porcelain tiles cold in bathroom areas?
Porcelain tiles are excellent conductors of heat and may feel colder than other flooring materials initially. However, they can be installed over radiant floor heating systems for added warmth and comfort in bathrooms.
How do I clean and maintain porcelain tiles in the bathroom?
Regularly sweep or vacuum bathroom porcelain tiles to remove dust and debris. Use a mild detergent or pH-neutral cleaner with warm water for routine cleaning. Avoid abrasive cleaners or tools that may damage the tile surface. Read More
Can I install porcelain tiles in my bathroom as a DIY project?
While DIY installation of porcelain tiles in the bathroom is possible for those with experience and proper tools, hiring a professional installer is recommended for precise measurements, complex layouts, and ensuring proper waterproofing and sealing.
Are porcelain tiles eco-friendly for bathroom applications?
Porcelain tiles made with recycled materials and sustainable manufacturing practices are available, making them an eco-friendly choice for bathroom installations. Look for certifications such as LEED or Green Guard to identify environmentally friendly options.
Can porcelain tiles be used for accent walls or decorative features in bathrooms?
Absolutely, porcelain tiles can be used to create stunning accent walls, backsplashes, or decorative features in bathrooms. They offer a variety of textures, colors, and patterns, allowing for customized and visually appealing designs.
What are the benefits of using porcelain tiles in the bathroom compared to other materials?
Porcelain tiles offer durability, water resistance, stain resistance, easy maintenance, and a wide range of design options, making them a versatile and practical choice for bathroom floors, walls, and other applications. They also provide a sleek and modern aesthetic that complements various bathroom styles. Read Full Article (Click here)
Are outdoor porcelain tiles suitable for all climates?
Yes, outdoor porcelain tiles are designed to withstand a wide range of climates, including hot summers, freezing winters, and humid environments. Look for porcelain tiles with frost-resistant properties for areas prone to freezing temperatures. See Outdoor Porcelain Tiles.
Do outdoor porcelain tiles fade in sunlight?
High-quality outdoor porcelain tiles are engineered to resist fading and color change due to UV exposure. Look for tiles with UV-stable pigments and a manufacturer's warranty against fading for long-lasting color retention.
How do I clean and maintain outdoor porcelain tiles?
Outdoor porcelain tiles are low-maintenance. Regularly sweep or rinse with water to remove debris and dirt. Use a mild detergent or pH-neutral cleaner for occasional cleaning. Avoid abrasive cleaners or tools that may damage the tile surface.
Can outdoor porcelain tiles be installed over existing surfaces like concrete or wood decks?
Yes, outdoor porcelain tiles can be installed over stable and structurally sound surfaces such as concrete, wood decks (with proper waterproofing and substrate preparation), and compacted gravel. Consult with a professional installer for the best practices and compatibility with your existing surface.
Are outdoor porcelain tiles slippery when wet?
Most outdoor porcelain tiles are designed with textured surfaces or anti-slip finishes to enhance traction and reduce slipperiness, especially in wet conditions. Choose tiles with a slip-resistant rating suitable for outdoor areas, particularly around pools or water features.
Do outdoor porcelain tiles require sealing?
Outdoor porcelain tiles are inherently resistant to water and stains, so they typically do not require sealing. However, sealing grout lines with a suitable outdoor grout sealer can enhance durability and prevent moisture penetration.
Can outdoor porcelain tiles be used for pool decks and wet areas?
Yes, many outdoor porcelain tiles are specifically designed for use around pools and in wet areas. Look for tiles with slip-resistant properties and resistance to chemicals and chlorine commonly found in pool environments.
How do I prevent weed growth between outdoor porcelain tiles?
Proper installation techniques, including the use of a weed barrier membrane and polymeric sand or grout with weed-inhibiting additives, can help prevent weed growth between tiles. Regular maintenance and weed removal also contribute to a weed-free outdoor tile surface.
Are outdoor porcelain tiles eco-friendly?
Porcelain tiles made with recycled materials and sustainable manufacturing practices are available, making them an environmentally friendly choice for outdoor applications. Look for certifications such as LEED or Green Guard to identify eco-friendly options.
Can outdoor porcelain tiles be installed in DIY projects, or should I hire a professional installer?
While outdoor porcelain tile installation can be a DIY project for those with experience and knowledge of proper installation techniques, hiring a professional installer is recommended for complex projects, large areas, or when dealing with challenging substrates and conditions. A professional can ensure proper waterproofing, drainage, and long-term durability of your outdoor tile installation.
Are porcelain tiles suitable for kitchen floors?
Yes, porcelain tiles are an excellent choice for kitchen floors due to their durability, water resistance, and easy maintenance. They can withstand heavy foot traffic, spills, and stains common in kitchen environments.
Can porcelain tiles be used for kitchen countertops?
Porcelain tiles are suitable for kitchen countertops, offering a durable and heat-resistant surface. Choose porcelain tiles with textured finishes or matte surfaces for better grip and scratch resistance.
Do porcelain tiles stain easily in the kitchen?
Porcelain tiles are naturally resistant to stains, making them ideal for kitchen applications where spills and cooking messes are common. Promptly clean up spills and use a mild detergent or cleaner for routine maintenance.
Are porcelain tiles slippery in kitchen areas?
Many porcelain tiles designed for kitchen use feature textured surfaces or anti-slip finishes to enhance traction and reduce slipperiness, especially in wet conditions. Choose tiles with a slip-resistant rating suitable for kitchen floors.
Can porcelain tiles be used for kitchen backsplashes?
Yes, porcelain tiles are a popular choice for kitchen backsplashes due to their versatility, easy maintenance, and aesthetic appeal. Explore various tile sizes, patterns, and colors to create a customized backsplash design.
Do porcelain tiles require sealing in the kitchen?
Porcelain tiles are inherently resistant to water and stains, so they typically do not require sealing in kitchen applications. However, sealing grout lines with a suitable grout sealer can enhance durability and prevent staining.
How do I clean and maintain porcelain tiles in the kitchen?
Regularly sweep or vacuum kitchen porcelain tiles to remove dust and debris. Use a mild detergent or pH-neutral cleaner with warm water for routine cleaning. Avoid abrasive cleaners or tools that may damage the tile surface.
Can I install porcelain tiles in my kitchen as a DIY project?
While DIY installation of porcelain tiles in the kitchen is possible for those with experience and proper tools, hiring a professional installer is recommended for precise measurements, complex layouts, and ensuring proper waterproofing and sealing.
Are porcelain tiles eco-friendly for kitchen applications?
Porcelain tiles made with recycled materials and sustainable manufacturing practices are available, making them an eco-friendly choice for kitchen installations. Look for certifications such as LEED or Green Guard to identify environmentally friendly options.
What are the benefits of using porcelain tiles in the kitchen compared to other materials?
Porcelain tiles offer durability, water resistance, stain resistance, easy maintenance, and a wide range of design options, making them a versatile and practical choice for kitchen floors, countertops, and backsplashes.
Are porcelain tiles suitable for living room floors?
Yes, porcelain tiles are a popular choice for living room floors due to their durability, versatility, and wide range of design options. They can withstand heavy foot traffic and are easy to clean and maintain.
Can porcelain tiles be used for living room accent walls?
Absolutely, porcelain tiles can be used to create stunning accent walls in living rooms. They offer a variety of textures, colors, and patterns, allowing for customized and visually appealing accent wall designs.
Do porcelain tiles require sealing for living room applications?
Porcelain tiles are naturally resistant to stains and moisture, so they typically do not require sealing for living room applications. However, sealing grout lines with a suitable grout sealer can enhance durability and prevent staining.
Are porcelain tiles cold in living rooms?
Porcelain tiles are excellent conductors of heat and may feel colder than other flooring materials initially. However, they can be installed over radiant floor heating systems for added warmth and comfort in living rooms.
Can porcelain tiles be installed over existing flooring in the living room?
Yes, porcelain tiles can be installed over stable and properly prepared existing flooring surfaces in the living room. Ensure the subfloor is clean, level, and free from any defects before installation.
Do porcelain tiles scratch easily in living room areas?
Porcelain tiles are highly durable and resistant to scratches, making them suitable for high-traffic living room areas. However, it's essential to use furniture pads or coasters to protect the tile surface from scratches caused by furniture movement.
Can I install porcelain tiles in my living room as a DIY project?
While DIY installation of porcelain tiles in the living room is possible for those with experience and proper tools, hiring a professional installer is recommended for precise measurements, complex layouts, and ensuring proper subfloor preparation.
What are the benefits of using porcelain tiles in the living room compared to other materials?
Porcelain tiles offer durability, water resistance, stain resistance, easy maintenance, and a wide range of design options, making them a versatile and practical choice for living room floors, accent walls, and other applications. They also provide a sleek and modern aesthetic that complements various interior styles.
How do I prepare the surface before installing porcelain tiles?
Proper surface preparation is crucial for a successful tile installation. Ensure the surface is clean, level, and free of any debris, grease, or sealants. Use a suitable primer or adhesive as recommended by your tile manufacturer or installer.
Can porcelain tiles be used for outdoor projects?
Yes, porcelain tiles are highly durable and suitable for outdoor applications such as patios, walkways, and pool surrounds. Opt for tiles specifically designed for outdoor use to withstand weather conditions and prevent slippage.
What grout color should I choose for my tiles?
The choice of grout color depends on your design preferences. For a seamless look, select a grout color that closely matches your tile color. Alternatively, contrasting grout colors can create a striking visual impact and highlight the tile pattern.
How do I maintain and clean porcelain tiles?
Regular maintenance involves sweeping or vacuuming to remove dust and dirt. Use a mild detergent or pH-neutral cleaner with warm water for routine cleaning. Avoid abrasive cleaners or tools that may scratch the tile surface. Sealing grout lines can also enhance durability and stain resistance.
Can I install porcelain tiles over existing tiles?
It's possible to install porcelain tiles over existing tiles, but proper surface preparation is essential. Ensure the existing tiles are firmly adhered, clean, and free of any damage or irregularities. Consult with a professional installer for the best practices and suitability of this approach.
How long does it take to install porcelain tiles?
The installation time depends on various factors such as the size of the area, complexity of the design, and preparation requirements. A professional installer can provide a timeline based on your specific project details.
What are the benefits of porcelain tiles compared to other tile materials?
Porcelain tiles offer numerous advantages, including durability, water resistance, low maintenance, and a wide range of design options. They are ideal for high-traffic areas, wet spaces, and both indoor and outdoor applications.
How can I prevent tile cracking or damage during installation?
Proper handling, preparation, and use of quality adhesives are key factors in preventing tile cracking or damage. Follow manufacturer guidelines, allow adequate curing time, and avoid excessive weight or stress on freshly installed tiles.
Are there eco-friendly options available for porcelain tiles?
Yes, eco-friendly porcelain tiles made from recycled materials or with sustainable manufacturing practices are available. Look for certifications such as LEED or Green Guard to identify environmentally friendly tile options.

Absolutely! Our Tiles Calculator handles both rectangular and irregularly shaped areas. Simply divide complex spaces into smaller sections, measure each section separately, and enter the dimensions into the calculator. Summing up the individual tile requirements will give you the total needed.

All standard tiles orders are delivered in pallets and to the curbside only. Purchases over £250 are delivered free while purchases less than £250 incur £45 delivery charge per pallet. This rate covers all deliveries in the London area zone 1-6.
Additional charges apply for deliveries outside London. To find out these charges, add items to cart and proceed to the checkout page where you will be required to provide delivery details. Input your accurate delivery information, and we will provide a pricing list.
Additional charges may apply for remote and hard to reach areas such as areas accessible only by ferry and military bases. These charges will be calculated after the order is received and processed. You will be contacted and asked to make payment for delivery, and your order will only be shipped out when such payment is received.
Tiling accessories, adhesive and grout are delivered as parcels and go out by courier. They will be delivered to your doorstep, and if our courier does not meet you on the agreed delivery date, a calling card will be left for you to rearrange delivery or claim products from your local depot.
Orders will be shipped out the next day, in 2-3 working days or 5-7 working days depending on the type of order. To find out when your order will be shipped, place items in the cart and proceed to checkout. Provide the requisite delivery information, and you will be notified when to expect delivery. You can select expedited delivery at checkout, and charges will be calculated accordingly.
Kindly provide correct delivery information at checkout, and we will notify when to expect delivery. For questions and enquiries, please speak to a customer service representative on 07877968447. While we handle all orders with the highest levels of care, and professionalism and hope that you are satisfied with your product, we provide and update our returns policy regularly to accommodate unlikely events. For more help you can mail us at contact@surfacestiles.co.uk or you can find us on Instagram & Facebook.
